Addable as a Lean dep (lakefile.toml require cslib scope leanprover); study + potential dependency.

name: zlinq
notes: Cysharp's zero-allocation LINQ with SIMD paths (MIT). Named by Aaron 2026-08-25 as prior art for vectorising the linear relational operators. Studied from its PUBLISHED DOCUMENTATION only, not its source, per .claude/rules/cleanroom-two-team-separation.md -- the licence permits reading, the wall is kept anyway. Three transferable findings: SIMD is gated on layout (TryGetSpan) rather than on the operator; checked and unchecked aggregation are two NAMED contracts (Sum / SumUnchecked, ~2x apart) rather than one silent choice; an arbitrary Select lambda cannot be auto-vectorised on a managed runtime, so its vector form is supplied explicitly. Notable NEGATIVE result: ZLinq does not vectorise Where at all. Full entry: docs/PRIOR-ART-LIST.md.
